question: India clinches 2 gold, 2 silver, 1 bronze on Day 2 of Special Olympics World Winter Games. In which event did Nirmala Devi win a gold medal?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Alpine Skiing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India clinches 2 gold, 2 silver, 1 bronze on Day 2 of Special Olympics World Winter Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India won five medals** on the second day of the **Special Olympics World Winter Games**, bringing the total medal tally to **nine**.
 
• **Bharti** won a **gold** medal in the **Novice Slalom Final** in **snowboarding**, marking her second gold of the tournament.
 
• **Harshita Thakur** won a **bronze** in **snowboarding**.
 
• In **Alpine Skiing**, **Nirmala Devi** secured a **gold** medal, **Radha Devi** won a **silver** in the **Intermediate Giant Slalom Final**, and **Abhishek Kumar** claimed **silver** in the **Novice Giant Slalom Final**.
 
• India is competing in **six of the tournament’s eight disciplines.**
